name: Co-precipitation - Metal on Oxide Support
description: Metal and support nitrates are co-precipitated with base to a target pH, then filtered, washed, dried and calcined. Reference preparation: 10 wt% Ni/Al2O3 precipitated with NH4OH to pH 8, dried at 105 C, calcined at 750 C for 3 h.

step_quantities.note: Precipitation with base to target pH
Filtration and washing of the precipitate
105 C overnight in the reference preparation
750 C for 3 h in the reference preparation

route_note: Adds a precipitation stage plus filtration and washing relative to incipient wetness, and consumes a base reagent the impregnation routes do not.
source: Co-precipitation, impregnation and sol-gel preparation of Ni catalysts for pyrolysis-catalytic steam reforming of waste plastics, Appl. Catal. B 239, 565 (2018)
